decisions.reason: Although it is farther from our traditional range, we would keep this UV spot varnishing system because its very public flagship launch creates strong pressure to justify the investment and treat any weak uptake as still temporary.
We would keep this sheet preparation module because it fits directly into our modular automation direction and another year on the market only deepens our commitment to the launch.
We would keep this B2-format multifinisher because it is central to our core offer and strategic messaging, making withdrawal especially hard to justify after such visible commitment.

We would keep this hybrid saddle stitcher because it extends our established booklet-making business and the launch investment is easier to defend than to write off in a still favorable market context.
We would keep this folding add-on unit because it complements existing equipment and the named customer application supports continued commitment rather than exit.
